title: fix(runtime-dom): resync replaced select options (fix #16099)
summary: A native assignee select groups people into Project members and Other people. Choosing Bob immediately adds him to the local project. His key and value remain bob, but changing the optgroup recreates the selected option. Vue 3.5.44 can then keep Bob in the model while showing Alice. The proposed fix checks the selection after the update and restores it only when needed.
